class.name: SyntheticARInterface
class.brief_description: Advanced desktop AR simulation with a generated camera image.
class.description: ARView creates this for backend 0. It supplies colour bars and a configurable pose/calibration, not live camera tracking or real planes. Use its setters for desktop simulation; presentation and debug controls are internal. Time uses Time.get_ticks_usec(), with complete packets repeated below the render rate.

method.name: get_session_state
method.description: Returns the current [enum PocketAR.SessionState]. ARView.session_state is the game facade; notifications are deferred.

method.name: get_tracking_reason
method.description: Returns the current [enum PocketAR.TrackingReason]. NONE alone does not guarantee tracking.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears presentation and planes and changes session generation. Retains the selected plane-finding mode. Prefer ARView.reset for a running view.

method.name: set_camera_rate
method.description: Sets simulated acquisition rate in frames/second, greater than zero and at most 240. Slower acquisition repeats whole packets between updates.

method.name: set_frame_id_pose
method.description: Internal harness control: derives camera position from frame ID to measure presentation consistency.

method.name: set_intrinsics
method.description: Sets focal lengths fx/fy and principal point cx/cy in physical image pixels. Focal lengths must be positive and image dimensions 32-4096. Applies to the next acquisition.

method.name: set_pose
method.description: Sets a finite rigid world-from-camera transform in metres in the physical image-camera basis, before display rotation. Applies to the next acquisition.
